remote_storage_target_binding_mismatch: Only the sole configured primary may manage follower remote storage targets
remote_storage_target_default_delete_req: Set another remote storage target as default before deleting this default one
remote_storage_target_default_error: The default remote storage target is not ready yet because it has a recorded error
remote_storage_target_default_missing: Remote storage targets exist, but no default target is configured
remote_storage_target_default_not_applie: The default remote storage target has not finished applying yet
remote_storage_target_required: The follower cannot accept remote writes until a default remote storage target is configured by the primary
remote_storage_target_default_update_req: You cannot unset the default remote storage target directly. Set another target as default first
remote_storage_target_connector_unsuppor: The follower has not declared support for this remote storage connector
remote_storage_target_local_path_invalid: The local target path must stay relative to the follower local target root
remote_storage_target_not_found: The selected remote storage target no longer exists on the remote node
remote_storage_target_single_primary_req: Remote storage targets require the follower to be bound to exactly one primary. Multi-primary followers are rejected directly
